description: Get the full AgentIndex record for one tool when you already have its id (from search_tools, get_trending or an AgentIndex URL such as agentindex.app/en/tool/<id>/). Returns name, description, long intro, summary, features, use cases, pros and cons, when to choose or skip it, compatibility, install command, license, stars, last update date, tags, rank_score, website and GitHub URL. Fields that were never filled in are omitted. Returns an isError result if no tool has that id; use search_tools to find the right id.

id.description: Tool id exactly as returned by search_tools or get_trending, usually "<github-owner>-<repo>", e.g. "hangwin-mcp-chrome".

name: get_tool_detail

summary.description: Short summary, { en, zh } or a string

title: Get tool details
